_comment: PER-LEAGUE bonus/malus scoring (spec v8 + set-pieces note v2). Leagues use NON-standard values for scored/missed penalties and set-piece assists: no value should be hard-coded. 'default' = fantacalcio.it; 'leagues' holds only the overrides relative to the default. Both the toolkit and the prediction engine read from here. NOTE on clean_sheet_bonus_gk: the source does NOT apply it - measured on 16,017 of our own keeper rows on both platforms, fantavoto = mv - goals_conceded + 3*pen_saved - cards is exact in 100% of them, and the residual is 0.000 on the 4,872 matches closed at zero as well. It stays here as a league-configurable term and every reader must keep leaving it out (see ratings._fantavoto and arrivals.keeper_fm_equivalent).
